item.title: February 2026 Breakfast and Lunch Menus
item.description:
Marshall Elementary has released its breakfast and lunch menus for February 2026. The breakfast menu includes items like breakfast burritos, biscuits & sausage gravy, French toast bites, glazed donuts, breakfast pizza, pancakes on a stick, and various other breakfast options throughout the month. 100% fruit juice, apples, oranges or other fresh fruit selection and milk are included with every breakfast. Choice of milk is included with every lunch. There is no school on February 16 (Presidents' Day).

item.title: Cold Weather Preparations and Warming Centers
item.description:
Students should dress warmly with coats, hats, and gloves for the upcoming cold weather. Families must ensure their contact information is current in the school system to receive timely notifications about possible weather delays or closures. Local warming centers are available throughout the community during extreme temperatures January 23-27, 2026, including multiple library locations and the City of Monroe Police Department (open 24 hours). For more information on warming center hours and locations, visit https://www.bcohio.gov or https://www.midpointelibrary.org/.

item.title: Reading Corner January Newsletter on Fluency
item.description:
The January Reading Corner newsletter focuses on reading fluency - the ability to read accurately, at an appropriate pace, and with expression. Fluency develops through regular reading and rereading of books and passages, not just memorizing sight words. Simple ways families can support fluency include: - Read and reread familiar books, stories, or short passages - Practice sight words as part of reading, not just in isolation - Read aloud to model smooth, expressive reading - Talk briefly about the story to support understanding

Helpful resource: Reading Rockets offers family-friendly tips and videos for supporting fluent reading at home. Contact your student's Reading Corner Teacher for help with these activities.

item.title: Health Reminder: Flu and Seasonal Illness Protocol
item.description:
The school is experiencing an increase in flu and seasonal illnesses. Keep your child home if they have: fever (100°F or higher), vomiting or diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hours after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.

item.title: Reading with the RedHawks Program
item.description:
Kemba Credit Union and Miami University Athletics are partnering to promote reading during the holiday break through the Reading with the RedHawks program. Students track reading hours from December 15th, 2025 - January 16th, 2026 using individual reading logs. Schools must reply by Wednesday, December 3rd to confirm participation and return completed logs by Thursday, January 22nd. All students who read 5+ hours receive two complimentary tickets to the Saturday, February 21st basketball doubleheader. Top readers at each school can win Kemba Club Account funds, and top ten overall readers win a pizza party with Miami athletes and Kemba Prize Packs. Schools can win $1,000, $500, $250, or $100 for their library, and top readers will be recognized on-court during the February 21st game. Contact (513) 833-0923 or agreen@miamiohias.com for participation.
